narrative_engine.thesis: trend down context (H4 stack down · D1 stack tangled · EMA spread -7.02 ATR · price holds below Day VWAP) set the SHORT bias. Price pulled back into the confluence zone 5.490-5.518 (VWAP band · POC · EMA pocket · PDH/PDL flip), where the footprint printed its confirmation. Risk is defined beyond 5.545; the first objective pays 1.27R at 5.478.

plan.triggerRule: footprint abs fired sell in short direction at the zone (absorption inside the zone)
plan.invalidation: structure beyond 5.545 (signal zone / ±2σ VWAP / 0.5 ATR buffer)
vetoes: M1 R 1.27 < 1.5 — reward does not pay the risk
